subject: Post-call recap: Novacare discovery + proposed MAP and next milestones
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novacare.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Novacare discovery + proposed MAP and next milestones
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.1.xlsx, Novacare_Security_Reqs.xlsx

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (attached) to make the next 6 weeks explicit so your team can coordinate internally. TL;DR: strong fit for a PoC focused on clinical documentation extraction (use case + cost savings estimate), but we need to align on decision owners and security gates.

What I captured from the call: 
- Primary decision criteria: extraction accuracy on 6-9 month notes, integration ease with S3/sandbox, unit cost per 1k tokens, and SLA for uptime during pilot.
- Economic buyer: Mark Delgado (CFO) — finance will sign off on pricing/commitments.
- Security/legal: Raj Patel (Head of InfoSec) will run the security questionnaire and request SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement: Kristen Li will handle contract routing and PO timing.

Attached: a first-pass MAP (Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.1.xlsx) with milestones, owners and target dates + the security questionnaire we discussed (Novacare_Security_Reqs.xlsx).

Suggested next steps (can we confirm owners/ETA?):
1) Emily / Kristen: confirm procurement timeline and whether a PO or SOW is required (target: 2028-07-20).
2) Raj: needs SOC2 evidence and answers to the attached questions (target: 2028-08-15).
3) Redwood: provide a sandbox for 2-week pilot + sample eval prompts; we'll seed that by 2028-07-19 contingent on NDA.
4) Schedule a 30-min alignment with Mark (CFO) to review commercial model and pilot objectives (target week of 7/24).

Can you confirm the owners/dates above or suggest edits? If that looks right, I’ll update the MAP to v0.2 and send calendar invites for the alignment meeting. I’ve also included a short recording of today’s demo in the Drive link in the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Novacare discovery + proposed MAP and next milestones

Nice recap — I added a couple of guardrails in column notes of the attached MAP:
- Pilot success metric: F1 >= 0.88 on annotated release notes sample set (owner: Redwood / Monica for eval harness).
- Data access constraint: pull-only S3 read replica + token redaction; propose an enclave for PHI-sensitive fields.

I'll slot in a small deliverable (sandbox provisioning checklist) for 7/19 and include estimated token spend for a 2-week trial. Monica — can you prep the evaluation test plan and sample annotation instructions?

Aditya
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novacare.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Delgado <mark.delgado@novacare.io>, Kristen Li <kristen.li@novacare.io>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Novacare discovery + proposed MAP and next milestones
Attachments: SOC2_Summary.pdf

Thanks both — confirming the owners you listed: Mark will be the economic approver; he wants a short exec summary and the pricing bands for pilot vs production. Kristen will own procurement routing; we typically do a PO for pilots but may need a short MSA for anything beyond. Raj (separate thread) will run the security questionnaire — I attached our SOC2 summary for quick reference.

Two constraints to flag internally: 
- Our legal team requires evidence for SOC2 in addition to answers to the questionnaire; timeline to provide evidence must be before procurement signs (we can agree to a conditional PO).
- We have a compliance window: any external vendor handling clinical notes must complete security gating by 2028-08-15 to be eligible for a September pilot.

A couple of asks from my side: 
1) Please add a short commercial appendix to the MAP with pricing bands (pilot 2-week eval price / production per-seat or per-token outline).
2) Would Redwood be able to provide a SOC2 report redacted or an attestation? That will speed Raj's review.

If you update the MAP with those items, I can route it to Mark and Kristen and get back with calendar availability for next week.

—
Emily Carter
Director of Product, Novacare Health
emily.carter@novacare.io | +1 (617) 555-2682
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@novacare.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Novacare discovery + proposed MAP and next milestones
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.2.xlsx

Added a v0.2 of the MAP with the following updates:
- Milestones with owners/dates: 
  * NDA executed (owner: Novacare legal / Kristen) — target 2028-07-18
  * Sandbox provisioned (owner: Redwood infra) — target 2028-07-19
  * Sample annotation + eval harness ready (owner: Novacare / Monica) — target 2028-07-26
  * Security questionnaire answered (owner: Redwood + Novacare InfoSec) — target 2028-08-10
  * Pilot go/no-go decision (owner: Mark Delgado) — target 2028-09-01
- Commercial appendix: added pilot pricing band and estimated token spend per week (high/low scenarios).
- SOC2 evidence: attached SOC2_Summary.pdf and note pointing Emily to our compliance portal; we can provide a redacted report and a scoped attestation.

Action items for Novacare: please confirm Kristen will route an NDA (or sign via the DocuSign link), and confirm whether a PO is your preferred pilot procurement instrument. I’ll prep the eval test plan and upload the sample prompts to the Drive folder by EOD.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmations, Emily. I updated the HubSpot deal with the v0.2 MAP and pricing appendix (link in related_links). I also created a short meeting invite for a 30-min finance alignment with Mark the week of 7/24; Kristen, please let me know if you prefer an alternate time.

Next immediate asks (we’ll track these in the MAP):
- Kristen: route the NDA via DocuSign (link below) or confirm PO route by EOD Monday, 7/17.
- Raj/InfoSec: I’ll drop the SOC2 redacted report and an attestation link into the Drive folder — Monica will follow with the eval plan.
- Aditya/Monica: provision sandbox and the eval harness by 7/19; Monica will seed sample prompts for Novacare to annotate.

Recording of today’s call: https://drive.google.com/open?id=call-recording-20280712 (attached).

If that looks good, I’ll publish MAP v0.2 as the working artifact and track milestone progress weekly.

Thanks everyone — talk soon.
